# English

## What's changed

<!-- app-update-notes:en:start -->
### Added
- **Android conversations:** Read Antigravity and Codex conversation pages from an online source only when requested.
- **Conversation switch:** Desktop Settings → Multi-device Sync now has a conversation query switch, enabled by default. Changes apply immediately. Standalone Hub/Agent processes still require an explicit opt-in; bodies are never persisted by the Hub.
### Changed
- Desktop updates use this fork. Release builds require Node 22/24 verification and publish unsigned Windows x64 and Linux Debian / AppImage packages.
<!-- app-update-notes:en:end -->
## Download

- **Windows Installer** — [Token-Monitor-Setup-0.91.1.exe](https://github.com/AoXIUy/token-monitor/releases/download/v0.91.1/Token-Monitor-Setup-0.91.1.exe) (recommended)
- **Windows Portable** — [Token-Monitor-0.91.1.exe](https://github.com/AoXIUy/token-monitor/releases/download/v0.91.1/Token-Monitor-0.91.1.exe) (no install required)
- **Linux amd64** — [Token-Monitor-0.91.1-amd64.deb](https://github.com/AoXIUy/token-monitor/releases/download/v0.91.1/Token-Monitor-0.91.1-amd64.deb)
- **Linux x86_64 AppImage** — [Token-Monitor-0.91.1-x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/AoXIUy/token-monitor/releases/download/v0.91.1/Token-Monitor-0.91.1-x86_64.AppImage)

<details>
<summary><strong>First launch and other notes</strong></summary>

### First launch

**Windows:** Unsigned fork executables; Windows may show an unknown publisher warning.

**Linux:** `.deb`: `sudo apt install ./Token-Monitor-0.91.1-amd64.deb`; AppImage: `chmod +x Token-Monitor-0.91.1-x86_64.AppImage` then run it.

### Other notes

This fork publishes Windows x64 and Linux Debian / AppImage packages.

### tokscale dependency

Tokscale is bundled with this app and updated through Token Monitor releases. See **Settings → Advanced → Tokscale** for the version and fork build identifier. Tokscale is MIT, open-source: https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale

</details>

# 中文

## 更新内容

<!-- app-update-notes:zh:start -->
### 新增
- **在线对话：** 配合 Android 1.8.0，按需查看 Antigravity / Codex 的提问、回复、上下文与工具记录。
- **对话查询开关：** 设置 → 多设备同步中默认开启，关闭和重新开启均立即生效。独立 Hub / Agent 仍需单独启用；正文不进入 Hub 持久化。
### 变更
- 桌面更新使用此 fork，发布前运行 Node 22/24 校验；Windows 包未签名，Linux 提供 amd64 .deb 和 x86_64 AppImage。
<!-- app-update-notes:zh:end -->

## 下载

- **Windows 安装版** — [Token-Monitor-Setup-0.91.1.exe](https://github.com/AoXIUy/token-monitor/releases/download/v0.91.1/Token-Monitor-Setup-0.91.1.exe)（推荐）
- **Windows 便携版** — [Token-Monitor-0.91.1.exe](https://github.com/AoXIUy/token-monitor/releases/download/v0.91.1/Token-Monitor-0.91.1.exe)（免安装）
- **Linux amd64** — [Token-Monitor-0.91.1-amd64.deb](https://github.com/AoXIUy/token-monitor/releases/download/v0.91.1/Token-Monitor-0.91.1-amd64.deb)
- **Linux x86_64 AppImage** — [Token-Monitor-0.91.1-x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/AoXIUy/token-monitor/releases/download/v0.91.1/Token-Monitor-0.91.1-x86_64.AppImage)

<details>
<summary><strong>首次启动与其他说明</strong></summary>

### 首次启动

**Windows:** Unsigned fork executables; Windows may show an unknown publisher warning.

**Linux:** `.deb`: `sudo apt install ./Token-Monitor-0.91.1-amd64.deb`; AppImage: `chmod +x Token-Monitor-0.91.1-x86_64.AppImage` then run it.

### 其他说明

This fork publishes Windows x64 and Linux Debian / AppImage packages.

### tokscale 依赖

Tokscale 已随应用内置，并通过 Token Monitor 发布版本更新。你可以在 **设置 → 高级 → Tokscale** 查看版本和 fork 构建标识。Tokscale 是 MIT 开源项目：https://github.com/junhoyeo/tokscale

</details>
